newsitem.title: USA: US gulf jet fuel helped by low sulfur diesel.
newsitem.headline: US gulf jet fuel helped by low sulfur diesel.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices were mixed Friday, with Gulf Coast diffs firming about a half cent in tandem with stronger low sulfur diesel, traders said.
Gulf prompt front 31st cycle 54-grade fuel was offered at 0.60 cent below the December print, while New York material edged lower to about 0.60 cent over, traders said.
"Citgo has been a big buyer of jet in the last few days," one Gulf trader said, noting that its Venezuelan parent, PDVSA, was continuing repairs on a downed cat cracker.
